generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A provenance-aware guard can track direct aliases but lose semantic origin or callable provenance when the value is transported through structural containers, allowing a protected origin to be recovered and used without the intended restriction.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Track provenance only on direct identifiers and fail to preserve it through object properties, arrays, spreads, destructuring, property assignment or index access.

reusable_control.procedure: For any semantic provenance tracked by a guard, execute adversarial transport through object properties, array indexes including shifted spreads, object/array destructuring, container spreads and property/index assignment, then remove one propagation edge and require the matching negative control to fail.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Model semantic provenance independently from value taint and preserve each relevant provenance dimension across structural containers, spreads, destructuring and static property/index assignment before evaluating protected use.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Do not accept direct-alias coverage as sufficient; re-audit object property retrieval, array index retrieval including shifted spread, object/array destructuring, container spread and property/index assignment with at least one discriminating propagation mutation.
